Creator Showcase

This community thrives on learning. If you want to know how games like this are actually made—look to these five.

the lights in the deep

Five Beacons Worth Following

Beacon 01 ↗

Brackeys

Unity Fundamentals

Teaches the fundamentals of Unity—the same engine Unknown Worlds used to build an ocean. The classic starting point for thousands of devs.

Beacon 02 ↗

Blackthornprod

Solo Indie Process

Shows the full solo indie dev process—from first sketch to shipped game. Proof that one person can build a world.

Beacon 03 ↗

Jonas Tyroller

Design & Iteration

Documents real design bugs and iteration—the messy middle of development that polished trailers never show you.

Beacon 04 ↗

Code Monkey

Programming Logic

Breaks down complex programming logic into systems anyone can understand. Creature AI starts here.

Beacon 05 ↗

ThinMatrix

The Long Haul · Devlogs

Shares the emotional, five-year reality of building an indie world from scratch—one quiet devlog at a time.

5yrs

of documented solo development, streamed straight from the trenches.
These creators make game development
accessible to everyone.
